verdict.rationale: Bitwarden documents that its Public (Organization) API is OAS3-compatible and publishes a compliant swagger.json definition file. The vendor hosts Swagger UI over an embedded OpenAPI 3.0.4 document at bitwarden.com/help/api/, and the Vault Management API for `bw serve` has its own embedded OpenAPI document. The probe's 404s on guessed root paths do not contradict the documented locations, but no direct downloadable spec URL was confirmed hands-on, and the spec is embedded client-side now that the standalone api.bitwarden.com/docs host is retired. missing for 10: a hands-on-verified direct download URL for the raw spec file, independent corroboration of retrieving the spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
